description: List the user's OWN listing-message conversations — threads they started about someone's listing, and inquiries they received as a listing owner — newest first. Resolved from the authenticated agent key — only ever this user's threads. Use it when the user asks "do I have new messages?" or "who replied about my flat?", and before replying, to find the thread_id. It has no side effects (nothing is marked read), so prefer it over get_conversation when you only need an inbox overview or unread counts. Returns { threads: [...] }; each thread has id (the thread_id), listing_id, listing_title, counterpart_name, last_message_preview, last_message_at and viewer_state (unread_count, is_listing_owner, is_last_message_mine). Read a thread's full messages with get_conversation. Page with limit/offset.

limit.description: Maximum results to return per page, 1-50. Default 20. Example: 10.

offset.description: How many results to skip, for paging. Default 0. Example: 20 returns the second page when limit is 20.

name: list_conversations
